topic.title: Topic Models and Interpretable Document Structure
topic.overview: Topic models explain document collections through recurring latent themes and the ways documents mix those themes. This cluster studies priors, dependencies between topics, inference guarantees, and neural training signals. The goal is not merely reconstructing word counts: useful topics should organize documents coherently and support meaningful interpretation or retrieval.
topic.whyItMatters: Choices that appear to be minor smoothing details can substantially change the themes a model discovers. Evaluation must therefore consider stability, assignment quality, and practical usefulness alongside statistical fit. Language-model guidance offers richer context but introduces another learned source of assumptions into the discovered structure.
topic.evolution: A 2000 representative jointly models document content and hyperlinks. Work in 2009 demonstrates the importance of asymmetric document-topic priors, followed by studies of correlated structure and neural inference. A 2026 approach distills contextual soft labels from language models and evaluates both topic quality and retrieval of semantically related documents.
openQuestions: How can users recognize topics that reflect modeling artifacts rather than corpus structure?
When does contextual supervision improve interpretability across unfamiliar document domains?

papers.title: Effective Neural Topic Modeling with Embedding Clustering Regularization
papers.tldr: ECRTM organizes word embeddings into separate topic-centered clusters to reduce repetitive topics and improve topic quality.

papers.title: Context-guided Embedding Adaptation for Effective Topic Modeling in Low-Resource Regimes
papers.tldr: The method adapts word embeddings through task-specific semantic graphs and clustering to improve topic modeling when data is scarce.

papers.title: Public Opinion Field Effect Fusion in Representation Learning for Trending Topics Diffusion
papers.tldr: A representation-learning framework incorporates competition among public-opinion centers and social-circle influence to improve trending-topic diffusion analysis.

papers.title: FASTopic: Pretrained Transformer is a Fast, Adaptive, Stable, and Transferable Topic Model
papers.tldr: FASTopic discovers topics by reconstructing semantic relationships among Transformer document embeddings and learnable topic and word embeddings.

papers.title: E-LDA: Toward Interpretable LDA Topic Models with Strong Guarantees in Logarithmic Parallel Time
papers.tldr: E-LDA provides fast parallel topic inference with theoretical guarantees, keyword-based interpretability, and support for downstream causal analysis.

papers.title: Improving Topic Modeling by Distilling Soft Labels from Language Models
papers.tldr: DSL improves topic learning by replacing sparse word-count reconstruction targets with contextual soft labels from a language model.

papers.title: Sparse Autoencoders are Topic Models
papers.tldr: A probabilistic topic-model interpretation of sparse autoencoders supports reusable topic atoms and coherent thematic analysis across text and images.
